name: one_line_explorer
title: One-Line Diagram
description: Renders a one-line (single-line) connectivity diagram for a selected node, exploring 2 hops of neighbours. ConnectivityNodes are displayed as bus bars.
author: Antigravity

requirements.description: Generates a one-line diagram centred on a selected node with 2-depth neighbourhood traversal.
agent_directives: Use this plugin when the user asks for a 'one-line diagram', 'single-line diagram', 'connectivity diagram', or 'one-line' for a node.
This plugin opens an analysis window with a structured diagram — not a force-directed graph.

_implementation_plan.summary: One-line diagram plugin. Selected node → 2-depth BFS over topology edges. ConnectivityNodes rendered as bus bars. Mobile layout: top-down (TB). Desktop layout: left-to-right (LR). Uses reagraph with layoutType='treeTd2d' (mobile) or 'treeLr2d' (desktop).
remaining_steps: Implement bus-bar custom node renderer in reagraph
Style edge labels by equipment type (Transformer, ACLineSegment, Breaker, etc.)
Add attached equipment (EnergyConsumer, EnergySource) as tooltip or inline badge on bus bar nodes
Add unit test for backend 2-hop BFS endpoint

backend.logic: Use registry.get_combined_topology to get all nodes/edges. Build an undirected networkx graph. Use ego_graph(node_id, radius=depth) to extract the 2-hop subgraph. Return filtered nodes and edges with attached_equipment included on each bus bar node.

files.model/OneLineModel.ts: TypeScript interfaces: BusBarNode, EquipmentEdge, OneLineDiagramData. Pure transform functions.
files.hooks/useOneLineDiagram.ts: Fetches diagram data, maps to reagraph nodes/edges, picks layoutType based on viewport width.
files.components/OneLineDiagramWindow.tsx: AnalysisWindow wrapper around GraphCanvas from reagraph. Props: instance, onClose, onMinimize.

node_rendering.ConnectivityNode: Wide rectangle styled as a bus bar (dark grey/blue, full width)
node_rendering.Substation: Wide rectangle styled as a bus bar with a distinct colour (amber/gold)
